2608.23353.title: FormuEvo: LLM-Guided Evolution for Discovering Solver-Efficient Mixed-Integer Programming Formulations
2608.23353.paper_summary: Mixed-integer programming (MIP) lies at the core of operations research and industrial optimization. While large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promise in automated MIP modeling from natural language, they prioritize semantic correctness but overlook formulation strength, severely bottlenecking the efficiency of downstream solvers. We propose FormuEvo, an LLM-guided evolutionary framework for automated discovery of solver-efficient MIP formulations. FormuEvo frames MIP formulation design as evolutionary optimization over the symbolic space of MIP formulations, represented as executable modeling programs, by iteratively generating, evaluating, and selecting stronger candidates via LLM-driven crossover, mutation, and repair operations. To move beyond blind exploration, FormuEvo introduces a solver-informed diagnosis mechanism that exploits fine-grained solver statistics as verbal gradients for targeted refinement. Additionally, a structured memory abstracts prior experience into reusable modeling strategies, avoiding redundant exploration while enabling zero-shot transfer to unseen problems and bootstrapping smaller LLMs. Experiments across diverse linear and non-linear problems demonstrate that FormuEvo discovers formulations that significantly outperform both expert-designed formulations and existing LLM-based approaches, accelerating solvers by up to 5.5$\times$, with distilled knowledge transferring effectively across problems and model scales.
2608.23353.paper_summary_zh: 混合整數規劃（MIP）是運籌學和工業優化的核心。雖然大型語言模型（LLMs）最近在從自然語言自動建模MIP方面顯示出潛力，但它們優先考慮語義正確性，卻忽略了公式的強度，這大大限制了下游求解器的效率。我們提出了FormuEvo，一個由LLM引導的進化框架，用於自動發現高效的MIP公式。FormuEvo將MIP公式設計框架視為在MIP公式的符號空間上進行進化優化，這些公式以可執行的建模程序表示，通過迭代生成、評估和選擇更強的候選者，利用LLM驅動的交叉、變異和修復操作。為了超越盲目探索，FormuEvo引入了一個求解器知情的診斷機制，利用細粒度的求解器統計作為針對性精煉的語言梯度。此外，結構化記憶將先前的經驗抽象為可重用的建模策略，避免冗餘探索，同時實現對未見問題的零樣本轉移，並為較小的LLM提供啟動支持。在各種線性和非線性問題上的實驗表明，FormuEvo發現的公式顯著超越了專家設計的公式和現有的基於LLM的方法，使求解器加速達到5.5倍，並且提煉的知識在不同問題和模型規模之間有效轉移。
